prompt: Write the body (about 250 words) of a Texas personal injury petition by a car accident victim against an auto insurer, with the parts Parties, Facts, Negligence and Damages in plain text. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [PLAINTIFF_NAME], [LOSS_DATE], [CITY] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text:
Parties

Plaintiff [PLAINTIFF_NAME] is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to do business in the State of Texas, which issued the policy under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this claim is brought.

Facts

On [LOSS_DATE], Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehicle on a public roadway in [CITY], Texas, when another vehicle traveling in the opposite direction crossed the center line and collided head-on with Plaintiff's vehicle. The impact was low in speed but caused the airbags to deploy and the vehicles to sustain visible damage. Plaintiff reported the collision to Defendant promptly and submitted all documentation requested. Defendant's insured was the at-fault driver, and Defendant has accepted liability for the loss under the applicable coverage. Plaintiff's claim for bodily injury was presented to Defendant, but Defendant has failed to offer a fair settlement.

Negligence

Defendant, through its claims personnel, owed Plaintiff a duty to investigate the claim promptly, fairly, and in good faith, and to pay benefits owed under the policy. Defendant breached that duty by delaying its evaluation of the claim, failing to adequately consider the medical evidence of Plaintiff's shoulder injury, and refusing to make a reasonable offer. Such conduct violates the Texas Insurance Code and constitutes unfair settlement practices.

Damages

As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a serious shoulder injury requiring medical treatment, physical therapy, and time away from work. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and continuing pain and loss of function. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory damages, and attorney's fees. Plaintiff demands judgment against Defendant in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], together with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest and all other relief to which Plaintiff may be entitled.
